title: Ripple cohort quarterly roadmap: sprint queue, hypotheses, and activation lanes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: define a sprint-level roadmap for the ‘Ripple’ private deployment cohort that balances speed-to-activation with platform stability. This ticket consolidates hypotheses (activation sequencing, compatibility gates), a prioritized sprint queue, signal definitions for go/no-go, and cross-team commitments needed to support 3 pilot customers in Q1. The output is a sprint catalog and acceptance checklist we can hand to ENG/Design/Sales for execution.
tasks: Finalize activation hypothesis matrix and acceptance signals (security, perf, compatibility)
Prioritize sprint queue into Must/Should/Can and map to engineering lanes (runtime, ops, console)
Schedule stakeholder review (GTMs, SEs, Success) and incorporate feedback
Create customer-facing activation runbook for pilot cohort
Define canary cohort cadence and rollback windows for each sprint
acceptance_criteria: Sprint queue has owner and estimate for every item in Must/Should buckets
Signals for activation (SLA latency, error budget, upgrade compat) have concrete thresholds and dashboard queries
Runbook drafted with step-by-step activation checklist and rollback playbook
Cross-team sign-offs captured from Security, SRE, and Customer Success
Pilot customers scheduled with activation windows and contingency plans

decisions: Use a 3-wave activation pattern (Alpha internal -> Beta pilot customers -> Public cohort) to limit blast radius
Pin the first two sprints to runtime-1.18 compatibility baseline to reduce kernel variance risk
Require Security checklist completion and KMS smoke test as a hard gate before customer activation
risks: Upgrade compatibility between quantized model variants could cause tail latency increases during activation
Customer network egress constraints in on-prem environments may require custom subnet whitelisting which adds friction
Insufficient observability for per-tenant token-level cost could make cost regressions hard to detect
metrics: Median inference p95 latency for pilot tenants - target <= 120ms
Time to resolve activation blocker - target <= 48 hours
Cost delta per-token vs. hosted baseline - track and keep within budgeted threshold
next_steps: Confirm ENG capacity for kernel compatibility tests (assigned to Ravi, due 2025-11-22)
Finalize runbook and convert to ops-checklist in Console (assigned to Ops SRE, due 2025-11-28)
Schedule GTM dry-run with SEs to validate customer comms and rollback messaging (Liam to own)
Add automated smoke tests for KMS/Key rotation to CI (ENG-21094 dependency)
notes: We opted against parallel full-customer activations after reviewing recent incident learnings from ENG-19804 (partial outage during large cohort launch).
Consider a temporary cost-sharing credit for the first two pilot customers to reduce onboarding friction. Finance to advise.
